notes: The contract's `semantics.role` of `button` lands on the `trigger` part, not on the rendered root. The root is a wrapper holding the heading and the panel so a single border can separate one section from the next.

The heading level is a required prop with no default. The APG requires a level that fits the surrounding document outline, which this component cannot know — see the contract's a11y notes. The contract has no way to declare a required consumer-supplied value, so nothing enforces it.
